title: Differentially Private Tabular Data Synthesis using Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Demographic Parity Difference (DPDiff) and Equalized Odds Difference (EODiff) on both the generated synthetic tabular data and the predictions of downstream machine learning models (XGBoost) trained on it, specifically by using controllable generation to adjust the representation of gender attributes (e.g., 'Gender is male', 'Sex is female').
